risks.title: Daily quota may remain incomplete before date boundary
risks.description: Free-source yield, duplicate saturation and bounded runtime can leave categories below target before midnight.
risks.residual_risk: Quota may remain incomplete when safe runtime or public-source yield is insufficient.

risks.title: Autonomous creation of missing My Drive workbook not certified
risks.description: Existing/precreated workbooks operate, but strict user-OAuth create→trash evidence is absent.
mitigations: Service-account writer fallback for existing files.
risks.residual_risk: A missing workbook may need human OAuth provisioning.

risks.title: Qualified privacy/compliance applicability for compiled B2B contact data is pending
risks.description: System compiles publicly listed business contact data across US/Canada while operated in Pakistan; ANPOS must not invent legal conclusions.
mitigations: R2 hashed fingerprints instead of full rows.
risks.residual_risk: Jurisdiction-specific obligations may require additional controls.

risks.title: Independent CODEOWNER review cannot yet be enforced without self-review deadlock
risks.description: Protected main has CI/no bypass, but the only verified owner identity is also the author identity.
mitigations: Defer independent approval until real reviewer/team exists.
risks.residual_risk: Control-plane changes lack a distinct approval identity.

risks.title: ANPOS coordination ref namespaces are not live-protected
risks.description: claims/** and supervisor/** are defined as locks, but no persistent verified Supervisor exists and namespace restrictions are not verified live.
mitigations: Worker dispatch disabled until verified identity.
risks.residual_risk: Namespace enforcement/gateway verification is required before future distributed execution.

risks.title: Cross-tenant lead or credential exposure
risks.description: Shared SaaS data, jobs, caches, AI contexts or exports may expose one tenant's records/credentials to another if tenant scoping is incomplete.
mitigations: Encrypted server-side credentials and secret-free logs
risks.residual_risk: Must be re-evaluated against selected architecture and threat model.

risks.title: Provider terms may prohibit intended collection, storage or resale
risks.description: Public accessibility does not grant permission for automated collection, persistent storage or redistribution. Rules differ by source, country, field and use.
mitigations: Maintain source/field/country-specific rights and provenance catalog; require qualified review and written vendor rights before activation.

risks.title: Paid API and AI costs can exceed SaaS plan revenue
risks.description: Usage-based source and model providers can produce unpredictable variable costs, including retries and concurrent schedules.
mitigations: Measure per-country/niche yield and per-accepted-lead cost; enforce tenant/source hard caps and never silently fall back to paid sources.
risks.residual_risk: Plan economics cannot be accepted until real vendor prices and expected usage are modeled.

risks.title: User schedules may drift, duplicate or starve jobs
risks.description: Timezone/DST changes, duplicate events, queue outages and retry storms can create missed/overlapping jobs or unfair tenant capacity.
mitigations: DST, replay, outage and failure-injection tests
risks.residual_risk: Queue/provider choice and SLOs are not yet designed.

risks.title: Mobile subscription flow may conflict with storefront rules
risks.description: In-app digital subscription and external web checkout treatment depends on store, storefront, app type and current rules.
mitigations: Defer mobile billing design until storefronts are selected
Re-check official current policies before implementation/submission
risks.residual_risk: Current target stores and markets are undecided.
